comments.author: person-2
comments.text: Fixed in main (commit 6688b35). Adding to the cart checks that the book exists (404 {{BOOK_NOT_FOUND}}), is in stock ({{OUT_OF_STOCK}}) and that cart plus new quantity fits stock ({{INSUFFICIENT_STOCK}}). Changing a quantity is checked the same way. CartItem now has a foreign key to Book with cascade delete; the migration removes orphan and duplicate legacy rows.

description:
*Found by:* code review.

*Problem:* {{CartService.addToCart}} accepts any quantity and does not compare it with stock. {{CartItem}} has no foreign key to {{Book}}, so deleting a book leaves orphan rows, and the null filter on {{book!}} in {{getCartItemsWithBooks}} has no effect.

*Steps:* POST {{/api/cart}} with a quantity above stock, or with a non-integer or negative quantity.

*Expected:* 400 with a clear message; quantity must be a whole number from 1 up to stock, including what is already in the cart.
*Actual:* the item is added.

Related: REF-10.

issue_links.summary: Add to cart: quantity 0 on the book page is added to the cart as 1 instead of being rejected

title: B3: Add to cart does not check stock or quantity; deleted books leave orphan cart rows
